policy: Human-reviewed reconciliation overrides. Each mapping must identify one OSM relation and one official CUATM legal ID, with documentary source and rationale. These mappings are applied explicitly and are not heuristic rules.

overrides.source_label: OpenStreetMap relation 10624607 tags + official CUATM identity
overrides.reason: Direct OSM inspection identifies relation 10624607 as satul Cornești (name:prefix=satul, official_name=satul Cornești, place=village); official CUATM distinguishes 9233 as sat. Cornești under Ungheni.
CUATM identifies Condrița as legal ID 0123 under Sectorul Buiucani (0120); geometric OSM containment under Strășeni must not override the reviewed legal hierarchy.

overrides.source_label: Republica Moldova — official administrative locality/code listing
overrides.reason: Official source identifies 9255 as sat. Negurenii Vechi in Ungheni; reviewed mapping resolves the OSM relation despite conflicting geometric parent assignment.

overrides.source_label: OpenStreetMap relation 10624608 tags + official CUATM identity
overrides.reason: Direct OSM inspection identifies relation 10624608 as orașul Cornești (name:prefix=orașul, official_name=orașul Cornești, place=town); official CUATM distinguishes 9202 as or. Cornești under Ungheni.

overrides.source_label: BNS 2024 census Chițcani commune identity + current CUATM legal identity
overrides.reason: Reviewed positive identity: OSM relation 6879649 is the stable «Sovetul sătesc Chițcani» administrative representation, while current CUATM identifies comuna Chițcani as legal ID 7612 under Căușeni (2700). This override binds legal identity only; it does not assert that the OSM boundary is authoritative CUATM/legal geometry.
